_doc: Post-game (M11): Verdance Bloom milestones and the Seed Ark loop (systems/bloom.gd). A milestone unlocks when ANY of its conditions is met. Condition types: thriving_hexes (Thriving hexes summed over every district), thriving_districts (districts with at least thriving_district_ratio of their land hexes Thriving), planet_pct (percent of the planet's land cells reclaimed, as on the hologram). finale: plays the Cradle cinematic (story/bloom_finale.gd) once. The Seed Ark opens after its unlock milestone: every bloom anywhere counts toward the next wave; wave n needs round(base * growth^n) blooms and pays reward * reward_growth^n. Nothing ever resets or is taken away.

milestones.name: A District in Bloom
milestones.desc: One district with 60% of its land Thriving.

milestones.name: Green Shoots
milestones.desc: Reclaim 0.25% of the planet, as the hologram counts it.

milestones.name: Verdance Bloom
milestones.desc: Three districts in bloom, or 1% of the planet reclaimed. Lumi's Bloom Core is full and the Cradle comes home.

milestones.name: Wide Bloom
milestones.desc: Six districts in bloom, or 2% of the planet reclaimed.

milestones.name: Evergreen
milestones.desc: Twelve districts in bloom, or 3% of the planet reclaimed.
